big_case.notes: A single-Justice stay application against a federal receivership over Arizona's entire prison health-care system (about 25,000 prisoners), pressing PLRA least-intrusive-means limits and state-sovereignty harm through a former Solicitor General. Regionally very large and a bellwether for institutional-reform remedies, but interlocutory, fact-bound (abuse of discretion after contempt findings), and disposed of by the Circuit Justice alone in a one-line denial without referral or any writing, so its national doctrinal footprint is small. Read formed from the record and the disposition; the staged prediction files were read whole, so the predictors' own scores were visible, and this read does not adopt any of them.

leakage.notes: Forward cell (prediction created 2026-09-27; event resolved 2026-10-01 by Justice Kagan's denial).
